text:
maya: Quick design review request — model catalog compare table and pin flows.

maya: TL;DR: folks — iteration ready for feedback. Focus: row density, performance badges, and the 'pin version' microcopy. Screenshot + prototype v2 linked.

sasha: skimmed — love the compact rows but worried about scanability. the metric cells feel cramped at 16px.

ken: agreed. can we try 20px line-height for the main row and compress metadata into a secondary row? current compare table looks like:
```
| Model | Perf badge | Tokens/s | Cost | Version |
```

ken: If we add a second row for model tags (quantized, fp16), we keep main metrics readable.

arjun: accessibility nits:
- focus ring disappears when you click a row — keyboard users lose context. need :focus-visible outline.
- performance badges are purely color-coded. add text labels and aria-labels.

arjun: quick CSS example:
```
.model-row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0a7; outline-offset: 2px; }
.badge[aria-hidden="false"]::after { content: attr(data-label); }
```

maya: good catch. also microcopy: current button says "Pin version" which is ambiguous — are we pinning the model or pinning to route? propose: change to "Pin version to route" and add a confirmation tooltip: "Locks this route to model vX.Y — use rollout to test variants." small and explicit.

sasha: +1 on copy. also suggestion: hover card on badge showing sample latency/p50/p95 and token-cost-per-1k so PMs don't have to click into model card.

ken: sorting: default currently sorts by name. For compare flow we should default to p50 latency or cost per token depending on user's previous preference. Is there telemetry for last used sort?

maya: yes, we have simple local storage for last sort in console. let's persist per-user per-project.

a11y-bot: Automated scan results for thread 1770123456:
- Contrast: performance badges fail 3:1 in dark mode for "Low" label. Recommend increasing text weight or background.
- Landmarks: compare table missing role="table" on the container.

maya: noted. can someone mock dark mode variant with heavier label weight? sasha, ken — any objections to moving badges left of name column so screen readers announce them earlier?

sasha: moving left is fine but watch wrapping. if badge pushes name to truncated state, provide full name in tooltip and aria-label.

arjun: keyboard nav proposal: arrow keys move between cells, Enter expands quick-preview, Space toggles pin. small JS snippet:
```
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') focusNextCell();
  if (e.key === ' ') togglePin(activeRow);
});
```

maya: love it. action items:
- ken: prototype spacing tweak + secondary row for tags (due EOD Fri)
- sasha: badge hover card content + dark mode mock (due Mon)
- arjun: a11y fixes (focus-visible, role attributes, keyboard handlers) (PR by Tue)
- maya: update microcopy and confirmation copy in copydoc

rm-deploy-bot: deploy queued for branch feature/catalog-compare-v2 — preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/compare/v2

maya: thanks everyone. will put updated copy and prototype link in the thread tomorrow. :raised_hands:
